dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, people usually use coffee to stay awake during overtime, right? Hmm. Do our Fungi friends have to work late too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? It seems like the taste of coffee has made our buddies even happier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Maybe it's best if we don't associate coffee with work!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If a little bit of coffee can help our Fungi friends keep playing without getting tired, that would be amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh, let's just make sure they don't get carried away and exhaust themselves. That'll do it!
